change_from_previous: spark-ds41f-1126 plus one advance: sparknet 1fd6a1fb (0.5.0) -> b01f350d (0.6.0) with the one-shot eligibility cap (vLLM 0710, SPARK_DS41F_ONESHOT_MAX_BYTES=4194304 at the switched shape's environment). Bare 0.6.0 measured a repeatable -3.0% prefill regression at 131K (multi-stage kernel displacing the tuned PyNCCL path); the cap recovers a third of it, and the capped arm holds decode parity (10/10 same both boots), identical temperature-0 determinism and quality 5/5 at a recorded, repeatable **-1.6% prefill at 131K** (8,459.7/8,461.1 vs the 1126 receipt's 8,594.8). Adopted on owner direction (2026-11-26) for upstream alignment with the residual attributed to 0.6.0's changed execution of <=4 MiB one-shot collectives; the code-level analysis and a proper fix are explicitly deferred to a post-window task.
